$comment: Copy this template outside tracked files and fill preparation fields, then build and run: node scripts/refiner-experiment.mjs prepare <run-manifest.json>. Input/evidence paths are relative to that manifest. runId format: 2026-09-10T12-00-00-000Z-<UUID>. The new directory is Task2_Goal1A/experiment-runs/<runId>; it must not exist. Pairs are {images: [exactFilenameA, exactFilenameB], required: true}. Chronology contains every model image, sequentialPairs every adjacent pair, fallbackPairs the union of sequentialPairs and loopPairs. Evidence paths point to screenshots; rationales explain overlap and visible drift. Commands are {executable, args: [], cwd}; record verified expanded commands, not guessed flags. exhaustiveTimeLimit and maxRuntimeSeconds are seconds; maxMemoryBytes is bytes. nonDefaultSettings may be {} if none. Baseline/acceptance fields marked pending may remain so at preparation; every field must be filled from retained evidence and both approvals before BA. No thresholds or approvals are supplied by this template.
